query: SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(stamp,'|' ORDER BY stamp),'')) AS "digest!" FROM (SELECT 'app:'||id||':'||digest||':'||revision||':'||active AS stamp FROM app_packages WHERE tenant=$1 UNION ALL SELECT 'rule:'||id||':'||revision FROM commerce_rules WHERE tenant=$1 UNION ALL SELECT 'flow:'||id||':'||revision FROM commerce_flows WHERE tenant=$1 UNION ALL SELECT 'promotion:'||id||':'||revision FROM commerce_promotions WHERE tenant=$1 UNION ALL SELECT 'channel:'||id||':'||revision FROM sales_channels WHERE tenant=$1) versions
